summary: With an execution environment enabled and its image set in the extension settings, right-click a playbook and choose Run playbook via ansible-navigator run; a Successful status means it worked, and you type play or task numbers (e.g. 0) to drill into results.
questions: How do I run a playbook with ansible-navigator from VS Code?
How do I view task results in ansible-navigator output?
What do I need to configure before running ansible-navigator in VS Code?
